Rita (PM): Quick sync — i'm consolidating long-term platform roadmap asks. Need to align routing policy work (multi-region + tenant isolation) with customer-driven priorities. Can we agree on gating criteria and launch tradeoffs?
Drew (Eng): Yep. Can you surface the top 3 customer asks so we can map to tech risks?
Rita (PM): Top asks: 1) predictable P95 latency across regions, 2) per-tenant isolation lanes for high-compute customers, 3) transparent fallback behavior + SLA when capacity constrained.
Maya (Infra): For isolation lanes we need: quota model (tokens/sec per tenant), placement constraints (region affinity), and graceful eviction policy.
Sam (SRE): Also need clear runbooks for cross-region failover. If we route across regions we must define what counts as acceptable data residency fallback.
Drew (Eng): From runtime perspective: predictable P95 implies bounded batching and KV cache locality. Need to decide if we prioritize latency SLO or cost for first launch. Those push in opposite directions.
Rita (PM): Proposal: Phase 1 (Q3-Q4) deliver region-aware routing + soft-eviction fences for top 10 customers. Phase 2: full tenant-lanes with SLA for reserved capacity. Phase gating: must hit 100ms median extra hop and <2x cost increase for pilot customers.
Maya (Infra): Can we make gating more concrete? Suggest must-have checklist: - Autoscaling responds within 60s for 2x load, - Canary routing across two regions with synthetic traffic, - KV cache TTL/priming strategy documented.
Drew (Eng): Agreed. Add: rollout policy: start with compatible model variants (quantized fallback) before cross-region migration. We need a compatibility matrix between model versions and routing policies.
Sam (SRE): Ops acceptance: monitoring must include token-level cost, regional latency heatmap, and per-tenant error budget burn-down. If error budget exceeds threshold, automatic rollback to fallback model or region.
Rita (PM): Customer asks also include contract language: we need to present migration windows and expected downtime. Sales wants an onramp checklist for Dedicated/Dedicated+Private customers.
Drew (Eng): Technical unknowns: network egress costs for cross-region routing, serialization overhead for telemetry, and KV cache priming cold-start penalty. We should spike on egress modeling + a small perf harness.
Maya (Infra): I'll run an egress cost projection for three major clouds and mock a priming experiment (100 tenant mix). ETA 2 weeks.
Rita (PM): Can we draft launch criteria matrix now? Thinking columns: customer priority, infra gating, runtime gating, SRE gating, docs/contract. Each row: pilot, canary, GA.
Sam (SRE): I'll add runbook checkboxes: incident playbook for partial region outage, SLA compensation flow, and telemetry alert thresholds.
Drew (Eng): For the runtime gating row: must validate that KV cache hit rate >= 80% under steady state for pilot customers; batching tail latency < target. We can simulate using replay traces.
Rita (PM): Good. Next step: Drew + Maya + Sam to own their gating rows. I'll consolidate into roadmap doc and get stakeholder approvals (sales/legal/product) by EOW.
Drew (Eng): I'll own runtime spike and compatibility matrix.
Maya (Infra): I'll own infra experiments and cost model.
Sam (SRE): I'll draft runbooks and alerting templates.
OpsBot: reminder: weekly "platform-roadmap" sync scheduled Tue 10:00. Added action items to project board. :white_check_mark:
Rita (PM): Thanks — can each owner post a 1-paragraph plan in this thread by Thu so i can fold into the product spec?
Drew (Eng): Will do. Short plan: spike for 2 weeks to measure KV warmup, implement compatibility matrix, run replay tests.
Maya (Infra): Will do. Short plan: egress cost model + priming experiment, infra checklist for autoscale and placement constraints.
Sam (SRE): Will do. Short plan: incident/playbook drafts, telemetry dashboard mocks, alert thresholds proposal.
Rita (PM): Great. If anyone has customer-specific constraints (data residency, contract clauses) paste them here. I'll pull into the legal handoff.
Drew (Eng): FYI — this has implications for Optimize: quantization recommendations will need to be region-aware if we split model variants. Heads up to ML folks.
Maya (Infra): Noted. I'll coordinate with ML infra on model placement hooks.
Rita (PM): Closing the loop: i'll publish the gating matrix and a timeline for pilot invites after we get the owners' paragraphs. Thanks everyone.
Sam (SRE): :thumbsup:
OpsBot: ticket created: PLAT-4921 "routing+isolation gating matrix" assigned to Rita (PM) and team.
